name: Precise Clean

features.text: Removes compound haze, swirl marks and holograms
Eliminates P2000 grit and finer sanding scratches
Targets light oxidation and surface imperfections
Controlled abrasive breakdown for smooth, uniform results
No dusting, no sticking, extended work time

description: PRECISE ™ CLEAN is a micro abrasive polish designed to remove 2000 grit scratches and swirl marks. Formulated to remove surface imperfections, surface blemishes, holograms, and oxidation leaving the paints surface smooth and glossy. PRECISE ™ CLEAN is body shop safe and does not contain silicone, wax, or fillers.
application: Directions: For use with a DA polisher or rotary buffer. Apply product directly to a cool surface working a small area at a time approximately 2’ x 2’. Work product until it is almost dry. Wipe off excess material with a clean microfiber towel. Repeat process until desired results are achieved. Formulated to be used with foams pads. DA Orbitals - use 70336 MF cut / polish or 70326 foam polish pads
